sql: SELECT TOP 10 dv.AttributeDefaultValueCode AS optionCode, dvl.AttributeDefaultValue AS optionValue, dv.PimAttributeDefaultValueId AS optionId FROM dbo.ZnodePimAttribute a INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttributeDefaultValue dv ON dv.PimAttributeId = a.PimAttributeId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttributeDefaultValueLocale dvl ON dvl.PimAttributeDefaultValueId = dv.PimAttributeDefaultValueId WHERE a.AttributeCode = @attributeCode AND dvl.LocaleId = @localeId ORDER BY dv.PimAttributeDefaultValueId
